text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the late-night outage. We saw a recurring pattern where certain prompt families trigger token-count growth and eventually OOMs. Need a short action list with owners and dates.
kevin: +1. My recommendation: 1) add focused prompt-set regression, 2) extend load tests to simulate cold KV-to-hot transitions, 3) a chaos drill simulating a GPU OOM + fallback verification.
jess: I can own the prompt-set regression. Plan: create a small harness that runs 10 representative prompts x 5 seeds, compares token growth to baseline, and flags >2x growth. Will PR to evals. ETA end of week.
maria: Good. Make sure the harness can target both hosted and dedicated endpoints. Example run:
```
python evals/run_prompts.py --endpoints=hosted,dedicated --cases=prompts/incidents/*.json --seeds=5
```
jess: Yup. I'll add a `failure_reason` tag when the length trend diverges and include sample outputs for easier triage.
rohan: I'll take load tests. Plan to extend our k6 scenario to ramp to 500RPS over 10s, include KV cold-start sequences, and ensure we warm/evict caches to reproduce the pattern. SLA check: 95th <= 300ms. ETA next Wednesday.
kevin: I'll handle the chaos drill. Test should simulate a GPU OOM on a worker and verify automated fallback to quantized/low-memory variant within 10s, plus emitted telemetry events `fallback.triggered` and `model.swap.duration_ms`.
maria: Who will wire up alerts when the incident prompt-set regresses? We want automatic escalation.
jess: I can add an eval metric `prompt_regression_rate{case="incidents/repeat-stop"}` and a Grafana rule: page if >5% failure across two consecutive CI runs.
maria: Paging policy: page eng-ml oncall P0, escalate to eng-sre if unresolved after 15m.
kevin: I'll link all PRs and tests to PM-432 and update the task with progress markers. Also want a short post-run checklist to confirm logs and fallback worked.
rohan: Observed reproducibility only when prompts included repeated stop tokens and beam-like re-entry. I'll add `prompts/incidents/repeat-stop.json` and a minimal seed that always triggers the expansion.
jess: Adding that file and a unit harness that asserts generation length distribution is within 1.5x baseline for normal cases.
ci-bot: New PR by jess: https://git.redwood/evals/pulls/129  (eval harness + initial prompt cases)
maria: Timeline recap: jess (prompt-regress) EOW; rohan (load) next Wed; kevin (chaos + telemetry) 2w; jess to add alerting and dashboard; owners to update PM-432 within 48h with links to PRs and test artifacts. Any blockers?
rohan: Need one isolated GPU for the load ramp tests so we don't affect shared capacity. @infra-team can we reserve?
kevin: Need read access to fallback logs and S3 bucket for verification. @eng-sre can you grant `kevin` read to `logs/fallback/*`?
eng-sre-bot: Access request ACC-778 created for kevin. ETA 1 business day.
maria: Also scheduling a 30-min chaos drill next Friday 10:00am with oncall present. I'll send an invite.
jess: :thumbsup:
kevin: lgtm
rohan: thanks all
